About Dr. Prashanth Pillai

Dr. Prashanth Pillai is a board-certified psychiatrist committed to addressing the intricate psychological and developmental needs of children, adolescents, and adults at every stage of life. He completed his general psychiatry residency at Jamaica Hospital Medical Center, followed by a specialized fellowship in child and adolescent psychiatry at Nassau University Medical Center and SUNY Downstate Medical Center. Dr. Pillai employs a comprehensive approach to mental health care, integrating psychopharmacology, cognitive-behavioral therapy, play therapy, mindfulness techniques, psychoeducation, and family-centered interventions. His patient-focused philosophy emphasizes trust, open communication, and personalized treatment plans to ensure the most effective care. Beyond clinical practice, Dr. Pillai is a passionate advocate for mental health awareness and reducing societal stigma. He actively promotes community education to encourage understanding and compassion for individuals facing psychological challenges. For those seeking an experienced and compassionate psychiatrist who takes a tailored, holistic approach to mental well-being, Dr. Prashanth Pillai is a dedicated professional devoted to his patients' long-term health and success.

Areas of Expertise

General Psychiatry Child & Adolescent Psychiatry ADHD Evaluation & Management Depression & Anxiety Autism Spectrum Disorder OCD Family-Centered Interventions Play Therapy Psychoeducation Behavioral Disorders Mindfulness Techniques Psychopharmacology

Clinical Philosophy

Dr. Pillai's patient-focused philosophy emphasizes trust, open communication, and personalized treatment plans. He believes in taking the time to truly understand each patient — their history, family context, and individual needs — before designing a care plan. He is a passionate advocate for reducing stigma and promoting mental health literacy in every community he serves.

Session Format

Initial Consultation (40 minutes): A thorough assessment of your history, current symptoms, and goals. May extend to 1–2 sessions depending on history, records review, and your preference. You will leave with a clear clinical impression and proposed treatment pathway.

Follow-up / Medication Management (20 minutes): Regular review appointments to monitor progress, adjust treatment, and ensure your care remains responsive. Follow-up sessions available in 20-minute increments.

In-person & Telehealth: All appointment types are available both in-person at our clinic locations and via HIPAA-compliant secure video consultation.

After-Hours Crisis Appointments: Available at 1.5× standard fee for urgent situations.

Ready to book with Pillai?

In-person appointments available in Reston VA, Oakland CA, and Honolulu HI. Telehealth available nationwide.
